name: avrdude
smoke_output:
avrdude: invalid option -- ?
Usage: avrdude {<option>}
Options:
  -p --part <part>         Specify AVR device; -p ? lists all known parts
  -p --part <wildcard>/<flags>
                           Run developer options for matched AVR devices,
                           e.g., -p ATmega328P/s or /S for part definition
  -b --baud <baudrate>     Override RS-232 baud rate
  -B --bitclock <period>   Bit clock period (us)
  -C --config <file>       Specify location of configuration file
  -C --config +<file>      Additional config file (*)
  -N --noconfig            Do not load config file ~/.avrduderc
  -c --programmer <pgm>    Specify programmer; -c ? and -c ?type list all
  -c --programmer <wildcard>/<flags>
                           Run developer options for matched programmers,
                           e.g., -c 'ur*'/s for programmer definition
  -A --keep-trailing-0xff  Disable trailing-0xff removal for file/AVR read
  -D --noerase             Disable auto-erase for flash memory; implies -A
  -i --isp-clock-delay <delay>
                           Bit state change delay [in microseconds] for
                           bit-banged ISP and TPI programmers
  -P --port <port>         Connection; -P ?s or -P ?sa lists serial ones
  -r --reconnect           Reconnect to -P port after "touching" it; wait
                           400 ms for each -r; needed for some USB boards
  -F --force               Override invalid signature or initial checks
  -e --erase               Perform a chip erase at the beginning
  -O --osccal              Perform RC oscillator calibration (see AVR053)
  -t --terminal            Run interactive terminal on its turn (*)
  -T --command <line>      Run terminal command <line> on its turn (*)
  -U --memory <mem>:r|w|v:<file>[:fmt]
                           Carry out memory operation on its turn (*)
  -n --test-memory         Do not write to the device whilst processing -U
  -V --noverify-memory     Do not automatically verify during -U
  -E -
